text:
maria_cs: Quick week0 pulse for Acero (private deploy) — can folks confirm network, IAM, KMS, and audit-log status? Noting a potential renewal risk if cutover slips >2 weeks. @taylan_se @jamie_sre

taylan_se: Network looks done from infra side. We pushed firewall rules to staging earlier. Need customer to approve egress 10.2.0.0/16->0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. ACL id: acl-0a1b2c3d. Waiting on their security signoff. ETA? :hourglass:

maria_cs: They said this morning they'd route to security by EOD. I'll ping. Renewal risk: they're tied to an upcoming compliance audit; if we don't get logs shipped before audit they may delay purchase. Marking as medium risk and flagging for escalation if ETA slips beyond 48h.

jamie_sre: KMS is almost done. Created key alias: alias/redwood/acero-prod. Need to add grant for service account: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-serving. Sample grant snippet: ```{ "Sid": "AllowUse", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-serving"}, "Action": "kms:Encrypt" }``` Can we get their KMS admin to run this?

noah_eng: IAM roles: we proposed least-priv model. There's one missing permission — s3:GetObject on logs-bucket. Example role change: `policyDocument.Statement[0].Action.push("s3:GetObject")`. I'll DM the exact policy diff to Maria in 15m.

maria_cs: Audit logs — customer wants to ship to their SIEM (Splunk). We recommend HEC over HTTPS. They need egress to splunk.hec.acero:8088 and an HEC token. Jamie, can you share the log-forwarding playbook snippet?

jamie_sre: Sending playbook now. ```# forwarder conf
outputs:
  - type: splunk
    url: https://splunk.hec.acero:8088
    token: REDACTED
filters:
  - include: /var/log/redwood/*.log
``` They'll need network egress open, the HEC token, and TLS verification with their proxy. Also call out that our batching window is 10s by default — may need tuning for throughput.

maria_cs: Ok action items:
1) Maria to chase security approval for egress (today)
2) Taylan to confirm firewall applied to prod after approval
3) Jamie to send final playbook + coordinate token rotation with customer
4) Noah to provide exact IAM policy diff and example role ARN
5) Customer to confirm KMS admin will run grant
ETA for all: 48h. If any delayed -> escalate renewal risk to Sales + AE. Assigning owners now. :white_check_mark:

kevbot: Reminder: onboarding-week0 checklist created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-4521

customer_secops: (from customer) We approved the egress for staging, prod approval pending legal signoff. KMS admin can apply the grant tomorrow morning. We'll try to get token rotation done today. Thanks, team. :pray:
